rule: SIM and EV for the 97 training-cohort labels must be BIT-IDENTICAL between the 6-cohort build and the 5-cohort build
note: Proves ferguson can only have acted through the CLUSTERING - the linkage, the cut and the refinement - and not through the signatures or the pairwise similarities. If this fails the control is measuring two things at once and the rest of the table cannot be read.

rule: cell-weighted ARI between the 5-cohort clustering and the 6-cohort clustering restricted to the same 97 labels
note: 0.90 is Gate 1b's own agreement bar (D-4), reused so the number means the same thing it does everywhere else in this project. PASS = ferguson barely moved the label space and the objection retires. 0.70-0.90 = partial, must be disclosed as a limitation in the write-up. < 0.70 = the 25-cluster space genuinely depends on the frozen holdout and Stage 7's number is NOT a clean zero-shot result.

rule: unweighted ARI over the same 97 labels
note: Lower bar than check 2 on purpose. Unweighted counts a 100-cell label the same as a 900k-cell one, so it is the harsher measure and a small rare-label reshuffle should not by itself fail the control.

rule: for each of the 9 clusters ferguson's labels map into, its TRAINING-COHORT members must still sit together in the 5-cohort clustering
note: The specific thing Stage 7 depends on. Even if the global ARI is fine, a change confined to exactly the clusters ferguson touches would be the worst case and the global number would hide it.
No threshold. tau is picked by guards over the whole node set, so dropping 9 labels can legitimately move it. Reported because a large move is the mechanism behind any failure of checks 2-4.

rule: number of clusters after refinement and SCC contraction
note: No threshold - a different cohort set may honestly support a different granularity. Reported so the two runs are comparable at a glance.
